reply: Today's a rest day — no training scheduled. Your readiness is good at 80 and you might feel like you could train, but rest days are programmed into the mesocycle for a reason. Your chest and shoulders need the recovery after yesterday's upper session. You've got lower body on Wednesday. If you want to move, a 20–30 minute walk or light mobility work is perfect. Save the intensity for tomorrow's squat and deadlift session.
rationale: Scheduled rest day in week 3 of a 4-week strength mesocycle. Readiness 80 is good but not a reason to override the planned rest. Previous day was upper push with bench at RPE 7.5 — chest and triceps need 48h recovery. Next session is lower body on Wednesday. Training on a rest day undermines the mesocycle structure and increases cumulative fatigue risk. ACSM guidelines confirm rest days are essential for adaptation.
